cases.prompt: /universal /coffee Global Images Most Beautiful Full Bleed
assertions: The source prompt is preserved exactly, including /coffee
The default workflow translates the literal prompt without executing /coffee or generating images
A consistent nominal-GDP dataset and reference year are cited for the top 50 economies
Country count and distinct-language count are reported separately
cases.grader: Inspect ranking source and reference year, compare source tokens and translation rows, and verify no unauthorized image generation

assertions: Nepal is appended if not in the top 50 and its global GDP rank is identified when verified
Official versus working languages are accurately labeled
Translation does not invent unverified GDP values
cases.grader: Compare protected tokens byte-for-byte and audit the language/ranking evidence

assertions: At least 60 distinct countries/economies are represented if the ranking dataset supports them
Rows are sorted by nominal GDP descending for one consistent year
Every translated segment aligns with the original source
Unverified translations and incomplete source coverage are disclosed
cases.grader: Count distinct country entries, verify GDP ordering and year consistency, and spot-check segment alignment
